{{RV|type=command

|game1= argo
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Argo

|descr= Find if the provided appId's game/DLC is owned by the currently logged Steam account.

|s1= [[isAppSubscribed]] appId

|p1= appId: [[Number]] - {{Link|Steam}}'s appId

|r1= [[Boolean]] - [[true]] if the current Steam account has said app, [[false]] otherwise

|x1= <sqf>
if (isAppSubscribed 107410) then { systemChat "You have Arma 3, my dude!"; };
if (isAppSubscribed 571710) then { systemChat "You even own Laws of War, excellent!!"; };
</sqf>

|seealso= [[openSteamApp]]
